The customer value ladder operates as a hierarchical Bayesian inference engine, where each tier corresponds to a refinement of belief over market signals. The Free tier initializes with a uniform prior over signal space, enabling exploratory inference. The Pro tier introduces temporal coherence and signal validation, shifting belief toward a more concentrated posterior. The Elite tier incorporates market-level dynamics, modeling latent variables that influence signal generation. Each transition is governed by information gain thresholds and cognitive load constraints. Failure modes include overfitting to early tiers' limited data, underestimating uncertainty in later tiers, and misalignment between perceived and actual signal quality. The system avoids drift by anchoring pricing to foundational logic in `pricing-phases.ts`, ensuring consistent behavioral incentives across tiers.
